examples.text: so aparena samayena rūḷhena vaṇena sañchavinā arogo assa sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṅ'gamo.

20982.meaning1: interest in sensual pleasure; sensual desire; sensual impulse (for)

examples.text: kāmacchando ca byāpādo, thinamiddhañ'ca bhikkhuno, uddhaccaṃ vicikicchā ca, pañc'ete cittakelisā.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu santaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ, atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando'ti pajānāti, asantaṃ vā ajjhattaṃ kāmacchandaṃ, n'atthi me ajjhattaṃ kāmacchando'ti pajānāti

20983.meaning1: obstacle that is interest in sensual pleasure; hindrance of sensual interest

examples.text: caṅgavāran'ti kho, bhikkhu, pañcann'etaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmacchandanīvaraṇassa, byāpādanīvaraṇassa, thīnamiddhanīvaraṇassa, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇassa, vicikicchānīvaraṇassa.

20984.meaning1: fact of absence of sensual desire, etc. and ill-will

20986.meaning1: clinging to sensual pleasures; attachment to sensual pleasures

examples.text: tassa kāmānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ appajānato yo kāmesu kāmarāgo kāmanandī kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho kām'ajjhosānaṃ kāmataṇhā sānuseti.

20987.meaning2: (the power of) fulfilling the desires (of anyone); (the power of) acting as one likes

20988.notes: (MW) kamaṇḍalu a gourd or vessel made of wood or earth used for water (by ascetics and religious students)

examples.text: brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchā bhūmakā kāmaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā udak'orohakā aggiparicārakā. te mataṃ kālaṅ'kataṃ uyyāpenti nāma saññāpenti nāma saggaṃ nāma okkāmenti.
ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā udāyī kāmaṇḍāyaṃ viharati todeyyassa brāhmaṇassa ambavane.

20990.commentary: (DNa) kāmataṇhā'ti pañcakāmaguṇikarāgavasena uppannā rūp'āditaṇhā. (SNa) sā kāmarāgabhāvena rūpaṃ assādentī pavattamānā kāmataṇhā

examples.text: y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatr'ābhinandinī, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā
so aññe satte passāmi kāmesu avītarāge kāmataṇhāhi khajjamāne kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāne kāme paṭisevante. so tesaṃ na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.

20991.meaning1: thirst for sensual pleasure; craving for sense pleasure

examples.text: katamā tisso? kāmatasinā, bhavatasinā, vibhavatasinā. imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ tasinānaṃ abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya …

20992.synonym: apekkhā, abhijappā, abhilāsa, icchā, kamyatā, jappā, nikanti, pihā

examples.text: yassa yassa hi raññā saddhiṃ gantu'kāmatācittaṃ uppajjati, so so ākāsagato'va hoti
brāhmaṇassa asiṃ ākaḍḍhitvā upasiṅghantassa maricacuṇṇāni nāsaṃ pavisitvā khipitu'kāmataṃ uppādesuṃ. tassa khipantassa nāsikā asidhārāya paṭihatā dvidhā chijji.
tasmā, doṇa, brāhmaṇo na pāyamānaṃ gacchati. tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī n'eva kām'atthā na dav'atthā na rat'atthā, paj'atthā'va brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho kāmado devaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, dukkaraṃ bhagavā, sudukkaraṃ bhagavā'ti.
dussamādahaṃ vā'pi samādahanti, indriy'ūpasame ratā, te chetvā maccuno jālaṃ, ariyā gacchanti kāmadā'ti.
dubhato vanavikāse, yadā dakkhisi kāmado, vane vāḷamigākiṇṇe, na rajjassa sarissasi.
sabbakāmadadaṃ kumbhaṃ, kuṭaṃ laddhāna dhuttako, yāva naṃ anupāleti, tāva so sukham'edhati.
kāmadadassā'pi, mahārāja, maṇiratanassa ekadesaṃ kakkasaṃ uppajjati, na ca tattha kakkas'uppannattā maṇiratanaṃ hīḷitaṃ nāma hoti. yaṃ tattha parisuddhaṃ maṇiratanassa, taṃ janassa hāsakaraṃ hoti.

20998.meaning1: realm of desire; world of sense pleasure

examples.text: kāmadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho kāmabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ bhante

20999.meaning1: ripening in the realm of sensual desire; bearing fruit in the world of sense pleasure

examples.text: kāmadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho kāmabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
